analysis_summary: Heatmap-style snapshot (rows above) shows clustered opportunities: (1) Short-sequence families (mixtral-8x, codex-lite, sparse-tiny) have the best PPK and are highly cacheable — pushing more traffic to these where quality permits yields immediate token-econ uplift. (2) Long-sequence or very large families (gptx-xxl, llama-3-70b) dominate COGS; these should be routed via reserved-capacity pools or offered as premium SKUs. (3) Quantized variants (redwood-v1-quant, fallback-small-quant) consistently cut infra cost by ~25–40% and should be the preferred fallback for non-SLA-critical calls. (4) Regional differences matter: eu regions show slightly higher infra per-token for large models — recommend regional price parity tweaks plus routing policy to shift tolerant workloads to lower-cost regions. Overall margin improvement levers: increase cache hit rates for conversational/assistant workloads, enforce adaptive batching on short-latency routes, and expand quantized model catalog for background/low-SLO workloads.
assumptions: Tokenization: ~0.8 tokens per English word assumed when mapping seq length to tokens
Infra cost numbers are steady-state amortized across GPU utilization 70-85%
License amortization is averaged per model family based on current vendor agreements
Cache hit rate increases are realizable with a 6-8 week engineering effort for prefix caching
Traffic shape used is representative of current hosted-api production (Nov 2024 sampling window)
recommended_actions: Prioritize implementing automatic routing rules: prefer quantized/fallback variants for >200 token requests when latency SLO allows
Experiment: enable 25% more prefix caching for assistant templates — target +15-20 p.p. hit rate uplift
Update hosted API pricing: add explicit premium tier for >512-token, gptx-xxl-class requests and a discounted background tier for quantized models
Capacity: negotiate regional reserved capacity for eu-west1 for peak long-seq demand to reduce H100/A100 spot reliance
SDK/default policy: expose recommended model family per use-case (chat/embedding/code) and default to mixtral-8x or codex-lite for short interactive calls
Ops: build an automated telemetry job to emit PPK per model-region-route daily and surface regressions in Optimize dashboard
